data.name: Baraaheen
data.gender_notes: Baraaheen is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who tends to the gardens, the forgiver. The name Baraaheen carries the meaning “Gardener, Forgiver” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Baraaheen usually hope their child will grow to embody gardener, forgiver and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the process of tending to one's own spiritual garden and seeking forgiveness for past mistakes.
data.etymology: Baraaheen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gardener, Forgiver.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Baraaheen total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: براهين
in_arabic.meaning: براهين هي جمع برهان، يعني الحجج والدلائل القاطعة
in_arabic.long_meaning: براهين هو جمع برهان، وهو الحجة أو الدليل القاطع الذي يبين الحق ويزيل الشك. في اللغة العربية، البرهان هو ما يبرهن على شيء ويوضحه، ويستخدم في القرآن الكريم للإشارة إلى الأدلة والعلامات التي تدل على وجود الله تعالى وقدرته. اسم براهين يحمل معاني الهداية والإيمان واليقين.

in_hindi.name: बराहिन
in_hindi.meaning: बराहिन का अर्थ है मजबूत सबूत और स्पष्ट प्रमाण
in_hindi.long_meaning: बराहिन नाम अरबी भाषा के शब्द 'ब्रहान' का संग्रह है, जिसका अर्थ है सबूत या प्रमाण। इस्लामी परंपरा में, ब्रहान का उपयोग कुरआन में उन सबूतों और प्रमाणों के लिए किया जाता है जो अल्लाह की शक्ति और अस्तित्व को प्रकट करते हैं। नाम बराहिन मजबूत सबूत, स्पष्ट प्रमाण, और विश्वास के अर्थ को दर्शाता है, जो इस्लामी शिक्षाओं में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है।

in_english.name: Baraaheen
in_english.meaning: Baraaheen means strong evidences and clear proofs
in_english.long_meaning: Baraaheen is the plural form of 'Burhan', which signifies evidence, proof, or demonstration. In Islamic tradition, Burhan is used in the Quran to refer to the signs and proofs that indicate Allah's power and existence. The name Baraaheen embodies the meanings of strong arguments, clear demonstrations, and conviction, playing a significant role in Islamic teachings and culture. It reflects the attributes of guidance, faith, and certainty.
